The '''Viraanntesses''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="RS" /><ref name="CS" /> from the [[Viraanntesse system/Legends|Viraanntesse system]]<ref name="Origin" /> in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Viraanntesse system/Legends|Viraanntesse system]]</ref> Their appearance was notable for ten [[Limb/Legends|legs]] and a [[Crustacean/Legends|crab]]-like appearance.<ref name="CS" /> The Viraanntesse [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jmmaar/Legends|Jmmaar]]<ref name="RS" /><ref name="US">{{InsiderCite|86|Unknown Soldier: The Story of General Grievous}}</ref> was a native of<ref name="CE">{{CSWECite|II|168|Jmmaar}}</ref> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="EAOC Vvaw">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Vvaw system/Legends|Vvaw system]]</ref> planet Vvaw.<ref name="CS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species origin of the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jmmaar/Legends|Jmmaar]] was first mentioned in author [[Matthew Stover]]'s [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|novelization of ''Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="RS" /> simultaneous with ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]'', written by [[Curtis Saxton]].<ref name="CS" />
